description: White canvas; grey rounded panel upper-center with serif text 'Q. What would happen if all the bodies of water on Earth magically disappeared?' and '-Joanna Xu'; stick figure (large round head, holding a sheet of paper) lower-left; empty rectangular board outline right; no water.
In a single frame the board gains a sailboat with a seated sailor (black ink) and a grey-filled water band across its lower part; Q panel and figure unchanged.
Sailboat with sailor floating on grey water inside the board; Q panel and stick figure unchanged.

Strong horizontal blurred pan (f951); new view with bracket '~6 SECONDS' and depth ticks '-60m -40m -20m -80m -100m' (order as drawn, unusual) on a steeper slope; small boats start in air then fall and settle on the slope by f1041. Cut vs pan at f951 UNRESOLVED.
'~6 SECONDS' bracket top, depth ticks left, boats piled on slope lower-right.

At f1211 view changes to depth scale '-1000m -2000m -3000m' with steep shelf drop and small black ship silhouettes in mid-air upper-right that descend slowly (f1251-f1370); by f1410 (58.75s) a new full-grey water scene appears with two black ship silhouettes with white bubble streams lower-left.
